mapper.insert: INSERT INTO diary (content, created_at, edit_deadline, last_modified_at, modify_count, first_weather, is_pinned, diary_date,source_type,import_batch_id,is_frozen) VALUES (#{content}, #{createdAt}, #{editDeadline}, #{lastModifiedAt}, #{modifyCount}, #{firstWeather}, #{isPinned}, #{diaryDate}, #{sourceType}, #{importBatchId}, #{isFrozen})
mapper.update: UPDATE diary SET is_frozen = 1 WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select:
SELECT id, LEFT(content, 50) AS content_preview, created_at, last_modified_at, modify_count, first_weather, is_pinned, diary_date,source_type,import_batch_id,is_frozen FROM diary WHERE diary_date = #{date} AND source_type = 'WRITE' ORDER BY is_pinned DESC,
last_modified_at DESC
created_at DESC
SELECT diary_date, COUNT(*) AS count FROM diary WHERE YEAR(diary_date) = #{year} AND MONTH(diary_date) = #{month} AND source_type = 'WRITE' GROUP BY diary_date
SELECT MONTH(diary_date) AS month, COUNT(*) AS count FROM diary WHERE YEAR(diary_date) = #{year} AND source_type = 'WRITE' GROUP BY MONTH(diary_date)
SELECT import_batch_id, file_name, COUNT(*) AS count, MIN(created_at) AS imported_at FROM diary WHERE source_type = 'IMPORTED' GROUP BY import_batch_id, file_name ORDER BY imported_at DESC
SELECT id, LEFT(content, 50) AS content_preview, created_at, first_weather, diary_date, source_type FROM diary WHERE import_batch_id = #{batchId} ORDER BY id
